_data_doc: Path to .npz file containing Young's modulus and labels. Required keys: 'labels' (uint8), 'Young_modulus' (float). Generated by preprocess.py.
_axis_doc: Loading axis: 'x', 'y', or 'z'. Domain length along this axis equals N_axis (unit-cube voxels).
_strain_doc: Applied uniaxial strain (0.01 = 1%). Displacement on far face: Δ = strain × N_axis.
_nu_doc: Poisson ratio (material parameter, typically 0.0–0.5). Default 0.3 for PA66 polymer.
_maxiter_doc: Maximum PCG iterations for linear solver. Higher values give better convergence but increase computation time.
_preconditioner_doc: PCG preconditioner: 'jacobi' (simple, O(N) iterations for heterogeneous media) or 'multigrid' (geometric, ~30 iterations grid-independent for smooth stiffness variation).
_smoother_doc: Multigrid smoother (only used with preconditioner='multigrid'): 'jacobi' (damped Jacobi, ω=0.67) or 'chebyshev' (polynomial, fewer iterations but slower per iteration).
_vtk_doc: Output prefix for per-voxel stress/strain in .vti format (ParaView readable). Set to empty string '' to disable VTI output.
